This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|yellowish-green]] skin.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[3 BBY]], one member of this species was present on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]].<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Ever Been to Ghorman?|fourth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" /> directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]] and aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
